core_obligations: Show the composite is zero: f_* p_* = (p f)_* = (q f)_* = f_* q_* by compatibility of pushforward with composition and properness of f, p and q (proof lines 3608-3614).

Prove surjectivity of f_* on cycle groups by lifting alpha = sum n_i[Z_i] to beta = sum n_i[W_i], choosing over each generic point x_i a point y_i of the envelope with trivial residue extension and taking W_i to be the integral closed subscheme with generic point y_i; then f restricted to W_i has degree one (proof lines 3617-3636).

Establish the cycle-level claim for beta with f_* beta = 0: split over each integral closed Z in X into the three cases J_Z empty, dim_delta(Z) = k and dim_delta(Z) < k, produce gamma_Z in Z_k(Y times_X Y) with p_* gamma_Z equal to the part of beta over Z and q_* gamma_Z = 0, and sum over Z using local finiteness (proof lines 3664-3708).
proof_roadmap: Properness of f, p, q makes the arrows defined and the identity f_* p_* = f_* q_* makes the sequence a complex (proof lines 3608-3614).
Surjectivity: lift generators of Z_k(X) along the completely decomposed envelope, the trivial residue extension giving degree one on the chosen integral subschemes (proof lines 3617-3636).

Kernel step: reduce to the cycle-level claim and prove it by choosing a birational model W of each Z inside Y and forming the unique component W'_j of W_j times_Z W inside Y times_X Y (proof lines 3639-3708).
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives exactness at the middle term of CH_k(Y times_X Y) -> CH_k(Y) -> CH_k(X) -> 0 for an envelope f : Y -> X, the descent input for identifying CH with K_0 of the truncated coherent category (statement lines 3592-3605, tag 0GU8). Surjectivity is a direct lift along a completely decomposed proper morphism, but the kernel step needs a real construction: for each integral closed Z in X one must choose a birational model W of Z inside Y, form the unique component W'_j of W_j times_Z W mapping birationally to W_j, and verify in three separate dimension cases that the resulting cycle gamma on Y times_X Y satisfies p_* gamma = beta and q_* gamma = 0. The case analysis plus the local finiteness argument are the substance, so the claim is H2.
